groups.title: MCFM per-point helicity amplitudes for interfering resonances
groups.notes: MCFM is compiled from its upstream source on your machine; RAVEL does not redistribute it. On macOS the build runs inside a Linux container; on Linux x86_64 it uses the GNU compilers of the compiler-bootstrap group.

qualification.basis: Linux x86_64 native route on AMD EPYC Slurm nodes: clean-prefix installation through the product installer (installer rc 0 in 2401 s, 8.3 GB), doctor ready and the installation check passed. Numerical qualification on the installed program (same installation; process 131 LO card, 20000 warm-up and 5000 block draws): the declared safety cuts are applied at sampling and recomputed from every stored point and excluded draw, the block is accepted as amplitude-integration accepts it, the point oracle (max relative residual 1.1e-15 on 4995 points), spin-0 phase closure, identical repeat, point evaluation (2.9e-13 against the block) and re-exclusion of the excluded draws in point mode all pass; a 100000-draw block passes the same checks. Measured exclusions: 5 of 5000 block draws (Z pT cut; weight share 9.1e-37 of MCFM's own weight), 54 of 100000 (53 Z pT, 1 small-invariant with unmeasured weight). The macOS container route is not rebuilt or qualified on this record.

groups.manual: On macOS the MCFM toolchain requires linux/amd64 images (Rosetta enabled in the Podman machine on arm64). Linux x86_64 builds natively with the GNU compilers of the compiler-bootstrap group.

groups.title: TeX manuscript compiler and class assets

steps.instruction: Install TeX Live with the full scheme (it includes REVTeX), or use an existing full-scheme installation, and record its version. In this prefix's bin directory, provide pdflatex and kpsewhich wrappers that set TEXMFHOME to this prefix's share/texmf and run that installation's programs. Put the sn-jnl class from the Springer Nature LaTeX template package in that TEXMFHOME, then rerun.

qualification.basis: Clean-prefix doctor checks in the reference-Mac qualification lane with a fresh HOME: pdflatex, revtex and publication-selected-assets ready. The prefix bin holds pdflatex and kpsewhich wrappers over the host's recorded TeX Live 2024 full-scheme installation, which the lane neither installed nor changed; TEXMFHOME is the prefix's share/texmf and holds sn-jnl.cls from the Springer Nature LaTeX template package. Minimal revtex4-2 and sn-jnl documents compiled to PDF. The evidence digest is the sha256 of the doctor's JSON report.

source_pin.version: TeX Live 2024 (pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.26, kpathsea 6.4.0, tlmgr revision 70080), scheme-full; Springer Nature LaTeX template package v12
source_pin.basis: The texlive.tlpdb digest is of the qualified host's installed package database (tlpkg/texlive.tlpdb): it identifies that installation's state, not an upstream TeX Live release archive. The template digest is of the zip downloaded from the publisher's URL above; sn-jnl is not distributed on CTAN.

refusal_classes.title: Loop decays of a generated spectrum
refusal_classes.refused: Decay widths of a generated spectrum need loop functions from Collier or LoopTools.
refusal_classes.why: The installer builds neither library and the spectrum route refuses decays unless the caller binds an explicit Collier or LoopTools build.
refusal_classes.would_make_it_possible: An installer entry in the spectrum group that builds Collier (owner default) at a pinned source, a doctor check for its libraries, and a spectrum run that binds them.

refusal_classes.would_make_it_possible: A pinned micrOMEGAs 7.1 source fetch and build in the easyscan group (source licence terms confirmed by the owner) and a doctor check for its binary.
